name: Bloomers 2000
source:
Divine bloomers were found on the Moon. An evil group BB group "Big bloomer group" seeks a way to make the whole world into a bloomer, and the international MIB "Men in Bloomer" organization monitors the subtle bloomer balance in the world. Their conflict becomes inevitable.
Tokiwa Ai is an ordinary girl who becomes chosen as a goddess of bloomers, and from now on she's a bloomers justice warrior!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
月球上意外出土了一条神圣体操短裤！邪恶组织BB团“大体操短裤团”（Big Bloomer Group）企图将整个世界彻底体操短裤化，而国际组织MIB“体操短裤黑衣人”（Men in Bloomer）则严密守护着世间微妙的体操短裤平衡，双方的正面交锋已然在所难免。
原本平凡无奇的少女常叶爱意外被选中成为“体操短裤女神”，自此化身为捍卫体操短裤正义的战士！

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
